records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Forest Moments PC cozy 3D forest game expansion environment concept, NOT a screenshot, no UI.
Primary request: a beautiful wide aerial three-quarter concept painting showing one enlarged main forest island on the LEFT and one much smaller nearshore pine island on the RIGHT, separated by a clear navigable sea channel. North is the top of the composition, east is right. Full silhouettes of BOTH islands fit inside the picture with sea margin; the main island takes about 70% of the land area. This is a grounded natural island archipelago, not floating land.
Layout: main island has an irregular broad wooded WESTERN lobe merging naturally into an existing smaller central/southern life area. The western lobe is deep pine forest with old asymmetric pines, a visible winding walking-loop path with open glades, a small low wet woodland crossed by a SHORT simple timber boardwalk. Keep tree groups broken into varied clusters so the trail and glades remain readable. Existing life area has just one modest warm wooden workshop southwest, one tiny fenced farm, a small freshwater pond in the interior, a pale southern sand beach, a modest wooden lookout on the north sea cliff, and an east-facing small wooden jetty. Buildings sparse, subordinate to the forest. ONE canoe with a tiny raccoon paddler on the sea between the two docks. Smaller island on the right has a west-facing landing jetty, a few large old pines, mossy warm-grey rocks, fern understory, one hollow fallen log and one readable loop path. NO buildings on the smaller island. The two docks FACE EACH OTHER across a short open-water passage. Main island remains visibly larger. No bridge between islands. No other islands.
Style: mature restrained storybook environment concept, hand-painted game art, soft sculpted forms with painterly wood and needle foliage detail, believable terrain, not toy plastic, not voxel. Deep pine greens #28453A, warm aged timber #8A5B3D, warm-grey stone #7D7A6E, muted teal sea, gentle amber sunlight. Calm late-afternoon daylight with cool very thin mist around the right island's trees; terrain and paths remain clearly visible. Warm pools of sunlight in forest clearings. Sea has subtle ripples and translucent shallows. Elevated oblique aerial camera, attractive balanced panoramic composition, no cutaway, no terrain cross-section.
Constraints: prioritize clearly different older life area / new western deep forest / smaller eastern island. NO text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, HUD, borders, mountains, castles, towns, tall fantasy towers, dense buildings, snow, exaggerated bloom or dense fog. Do not make the entire main island a circular mound.
records.review: 西岸裁切，保留首版记录。

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the provided Forest Moments archipelago concept. Change ONLY the framing: pull the camera back substantially, preserving the same elevated oblique viewing angle, to reveal the entire western/left coastline of the large main island. Both islands must be completely inside the frame with clear open sea around ALL outer edges, at least 6 percent sea margin at left and right and visible sea above all treetops. Complete the previously cropped western coast naturally. Keep all already visible relative landmark locations, island sizes relative to each other, trees, paths, sun direction, sea, warm storybook painted style, existing two facing docks and canoe. Do not add islands, houses, landmarks, labels, text, border or UI. Maintain a wide panoramic landscape format. This is a complete two-island overall design view, not a tight crop.
records.review: 完整双岛构图，保留西林与对向码头关系；不是现有场景的精确叠图，距离和建筑坐标不作实施依据。
